name: Fixer's Tale
source:
Welcome to the Scientific Research Facility "Camelot-22". The emergency personnel replacement system has chosen you to address the next unusual contingency. Immerse yourself in the humorous tale of a repair job filled with laughter, silly dialogues, angry chairs, and dim-witted robots.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2766400/Fixers_Tale/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到科学研究设施“Camelot-22”。应急人员替换系统选择了你来解决下一个不寻常的突发事件。让自己沉浸在维修工作的幽默故事中，其中充满了笑声、愚蠢的对话、愤怒的椅子和愚蠢的机器人。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2766400/Fixers_Tale/]Steam[/url]]
